DISC-GE-001 (2026-05-02): Within-cohort molecular-subtype hierarchy is robust under CHK-3.2 tier-3 substrate baseline shift. When CHK-3.2 fires tier-3, within-cohort subtype d-hierarchies are immune to baseline shift because all subtypes share the same baseline. VAL-126 STAD demonstrates: substrate shift -5.02 anchor-SD invalidates absolute d-magnitudes for cell-of-origin direction interpretation, but within-cohort hierarchy MSI ≈ EBV > CIN > POLE ≈ GS preserves prereg-predicted CIMP-amplification ordering. Operational implication for immune-atlas card: when interpreting EDEAR output under tier-3 substrate caveat, the within-cohort molecular-subtype/risk-factor stratification block becomes the primary load-bearing analytical layer; cell-of-origin direction predictions get explicitly flagged as pending-substrate-matched-anchor.

DISC-GE-002 (2026-05-02): ESCC vs EAC subtype discrimination on methylation alone via Caggiano TIM panel — first cookbook example of within-cancer histological-subtype methylation discrimination at >1 d-unit magnitude outside MSI-tracking-Lauren cases. Caggiano TIM panel produces consistent EAC > ESCC pattern across 13+ tiles (~2 d-units within cohort, p=1.5e-11 on Stage 1 alone). Operational implication for immune-atlas card: cards covering cancers with multiple distinct histological subtypes should pre-lock magnitude-based |d_subtype1-subtype2| ≥ 0.5 as a discrimination criterion. Future card preregs targeting cancers with multiple histological subtypes should include the Caggiano TIM panel as a primary discrimination atlas.

DISC-GE-003 (2026-05-02): Gene-promoter atlas reads target biology in target subtype (EsoRef Epi_stratified d=-0.99 in ESCC, near-null in EAC) — first cookbook example. Operational implication for immune-atlas card: gene-promoter atlases applied to multi-subtype cancer cohorts should be evaluated per-subtype rather than at cohort level. The DIFFERENTIATING_CROSS_TISSUE_OVERREAD outcome class is now bidirectional: when a gene-promoter atlas reads strong in cohorts of non-target tissue, the discriminating test for whether the signal is genuine cross-tissue gene-promoter biology or atlas overread is a within-cohort subtype split on a target-tissue-adjacent cohort.

DISC-GE-004 (2026-05-02): Risk-factor amplification within cancer cohort (Barrett-positive +1.69 d-units within ESCA cohort) is robust to substrate baseline shift. Operational implication for immune-atlas card: every multi-cohort card should pre-lock at least one within-cohort risk-factor stratification when clinical metadata supports it (Barrett for esophageal, MSI for STAD, H. pylori for gastric, pack-years for lung, BMI/diabetes for HCC, family history for breast). Within-cohort risk-factor stratification is the cleanest signal under tier-3 substrate caveat.

DISC-GE-005 (2026-05-02): Mixture-attenuation reversal — Stage 3 deconvolution atlases measure cell-type composition not within-cell-type drift. Pre-locked sorted-cell-d ≥ 1.5x whole-blood-d FAILED in OPPOSITE direction predicted. 40/93 tiles pass = 43%; whole blood STRONGER than sorted cells. Operational implication for immune-atlas card (FOUNDATIONAL): Stage 3 deconvolution atlases (Salas IDOL, Loyfer immune tiles, UniLIFE 19-cell, Caggiano TIM) measure cell-type COMPOSITION SHIFTS in mixed-population substrates, NOT within-cell-type chronic-inflammation drift. Cards interpreting Stage 3 results should anchor the interpretation in population-fraction-shift language ("T-cell expansion + myeloid depletion in whole blood") not within-cell-type-drift language. Future card preregs should pre-specify whether the disease is expected to drive a population-fraction shift (IBD, viral infection, sepsis, autoimmune) vs a within-cell-type drift (TIL exhaustion in solid tumor microenvironment). RE-FRAMES STAGE 3 INTERPRETATION ACROSS THE COOKBOOK.

DISC-GE-006 (2026-05-02): Stage 1 cycling-class architectural-drift panel does NOT detect IBD — informative null clarifying Stage 1 specificity. |d_CD-HC| < 0.5 across all four cell-type strata (monocytes, CD4, CD8, wh blood) on GSE87650 Crohn's cohort. Class-of-disease finding: Stage 1 is tissue/cancer-specific, not generic chronic-inflammation marker. Operational implication for immune-atlas card: card preregs targeting chronic-inflammatory diseases (IBD, autoimmune, chronic viral infection) should NOT pre-lock Stage 1 elevation as a primary outcome and should expect Stage 3 immune-fraction shifts to be the load-bearing readout instead. STAGE 1 PANEL SCOPE CLARIFICATION COOKBOOK-WIDE.

pairs_v0_3.one_line: Breast cancer is the cancer EDEAR catches earliest in pre-diagnostic blood; prostate cancer is the cancer EDEAR sees the cleanest cell-of-origin signature in tumor tissue.
Lung and CRC share architectural class but diverge at the immune-compartment compartment-flip: lung drives systemic immune activation in pre-diagnostic blood, CRC drives systemic immune tolerance.
Tissue-arm effect size ordering d(lung) > d(CRC) > d(breast) > d(prostate) is consistent with tumor mutational burden ordering.
Both produce immune-class architectural drift readable in peripheral blood despite BBB cfDNA limitation. Different patterns, both Pathway 1.
Substrate-as-discriminator is HCC gift. Same disease class, different substrate gives different signal.
AD and PDAC are the cookbook two canonical Pattern 3 cases. Both teach: pooled-null does not mean biology-null.

pairs_v0_3.one_line: Gastric STAD and esophageal ESCA share a cycling-class architectural-drift signature with subtype hierarchies determined by methylation drift mechanisms (CIMP amplification for STAD subtypes; Barrett-driven chronic methylation drift for EAC > ESCC); both cohorts share CHK-3.2 tier-3 substrate baseline shift on TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 (-5.02 vs -4.31 anchor-SD) reflecting GI-tissue-class structural distribution differences vs solid-parenchyma anchor.

Crohn's disease (and UC) is the cookbook's first sealed example of a Pattern 7 candidate population-fraction-shift signature: Stage 1 informative null + Stage 3 bidirectional T-cell-up + myeloid-down + sorting-eliminates-signal. DISC-GE-005 reframes Stage 3 atlas interpretation cookbook-wide: Stage 3 measures cell-type composition shifts in mixed populations, not within-cell-type chronic-inflammation drift. Future autoimmune cards (RA, MS, T1D, etc.) and chronic viral infection cards (chronic HBV, HIV, EBV reactivation) should pre-specify population-fraction-shift expected at Stage 3 with Stage 1 informative null.

Gastric VAL-126 (-5.02 anchor-SD) and bladder VAL-122 (mucosal cohort with tissue-class-mismatched CHK-3.1A floor, DISC-BLADDER-002) both surface tissue-class structural caveats on the cookbook-default solid-parenchyma anchor. Different mechanisms (substrate-distribution shift vs floor parameterization mismatch) but related lesson: tissue-class-aware calibration is the v0.2+ path to clean cross-cohort interpretation.

Esophageal VAL-127 EsoRef Epi_stratified d=-0.99 in ESCC and d=-0.05 in EAC extends DISC-PROSTATE-002 magnitude-based |d| threshold doctrine: gene-promoter atlases applied to multi-subtype cancer cohorts should be evaluated PER-SUBTYPE rather than at cohort level. ESCC retains squamous-stratified epithelial origin signature; EAC loses the cell-of-origin signature. First cookbook example of a gene-promoter atlas reading its target biology in one disease subtype within the same multi-cohort sprint (DISC-GE-003).

CHK_3_1_raw_beta_distribution.rule: Real raw beta is bimodal: >30% at extremes (<0.1 or >0.9) AND <10% in middle (0.4-0.6)

ccl_031_five_pattern_taxonomy_v0_3.single_sentence_rule_verbatim: Bidirectional cancellation is the AD-instance pattern: Test 1 pooled A_immune nulls cross-cohort AND a directional plus-or-minus 1 z-scored panel built on the same Stage 1 panel passes on holdout.

pattern_7_population_fraction_shift_sign.description: Stage 1 INFORMATIVE NULL across all cell-type strata (cycling-class architectural-drift panel does not detect the disease) AND Stage 3 BIDIRECTIONAL by population-fraction-shift mechanism (T-cell expansion + myeloid depletion or vice versa) AND sorted-cell substrate ELIMINATES the signal (mixture-attenuation reversal: sorted d SMALLER than whole-blood d, OPPOSITE direction predicted by mixture-attenuation hypothesis).
pattern_7_population_fraction_shift_sign.sealed_canonical_case: Crohn's disease + UC on GSE87650 GPL13534 (VAL-128 sealed 2026-05-02). Stage 1 |d_CD-HC| < 0.5 across all cell-type strata. Stage 3 max |d_CD-HC| = 1.72 on UniLIFE aCD8Tnv. Sorted-cell sub-experiment: 40/93 tiles pass = 43% (whole blood STRONGER than sorted; OPPOSITE direction predicted).
pattern_7_population_fraction_shift_sign.distinguishing_test: (1) Stage 1 NULL across all strata. (2) Stage 3 bidirectional with cross-atlas reproduction. (3) Sorted-cell substrate vs whole-blood substrate yields SMALLER signal in sorted (opposite of mixture-attenuation prediction). When all three checks pass, Pattern 7 fires. Distinct from Pattern 3 (AD-instance pooled-null + directional-pass): Pattern 3 has the directional signature WITHIN the Stage 1 panel via z-scored decomposition; Pattern 7 has Stage 1 NULL with the signature living in Stage 3 cell-fraction deconvolution. Distinct from Pattern 6 (substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohort): Pattern 6 is methodology — bulk-WGBS atlas family on mucosal cohort produces inflated A-scores; Pattern 7 is biology — population-fraction-shift in mixed-population substrate.
pattern_7_population_fraction_shift_sign.expected_diseases: IBD (Crohn's, UC) — sealed VAL-128. Predicted: chronic viral infection (HIV chronic, chronic HBV, EBV reactivation), autoimmune diseases driving peripheral immune-population shifts (rheumatoid arthritis active, multiple sclerosis active flare, T1D active autoimmune phase), sepsis acute, GVHD post-transplant. NOT predicted: solid tumor TIL exhaustion (within-cell-type drift; produces Pattern 1 or 2).

AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.case: AD pooled A_immune AIBL n=726 d=+0.077 NULL (VAL-050). 7-CpG Rule A directional d=+0.624 (VAL-051). Cross-platform AddNeuroMed d=+0.33; age-adjusted residual d=+0.12 (VAL-052).
AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.doctrine: Pooled-entropy is not always sufficient. Directional weighting recovers signed signal when per-CpG direction is balanced bidirectional.
AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.card_consequence: Every Stage 1 design must answer CCL-027 question (iii).
AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.mechanism_caveat_ccl_028: AD directional recovery operationally robust but mechanistically unresolved. Three candidates: (a) lineage cancellation; (b) z-scoring sensitivity gain; (c) cohort/batch structure. Test 2 pending OQ-2026-01.

HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.case: HCC ccfDNA VAL-059 GSE298812 paired d=+0.6336 p=0.0024 sex-stratified male d=+0.998 female d=+0.497. HCC whole-blood VAL-059 GSE281691 controls=metabolic-liver-disease d=-0.1556 NULL.
HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.doctrine: Substrate choice IS part of the immune-class signature. For diseases of secretory organs that do not trigger massive systemic immune drift in healthy peripheral leukocytes, ccfDNA may be the right substrate even when whole-blood reads NULL.
HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.card_consequence: Future card builds must document substrate dichotomies as part of Stage 1 specification, not as failures.
HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.bonus_finding_dose_response: Monotonic A-score progression healthy->fibrosis->cirrhosis->HCC (0.576->0.591->0.592->0.598). Signal scales with disease stage.

glioma_gift_orthogonal_vs_inverted_ccl_0.case: v0.1 predicted Stage 1 NEGATIVE per Bracci 2022 cell-fraction prior. VAL-088 read d=+0.91 POSITIVE. v0.1 sealed O5_POSITIVE_INVERTED. VAL-090 confirmed Bracci 2022 cell-fraction (neutrophils +16% lymphocytes -13%) AND cortical-neuron deconvolution d=+1.96.
glioma_gift_orthogonal_vs_inverted_ccl_0.doctrine: Cell-fraction direction and A-score direction are NOT opposite axes - they are orthogonal axes, different lenses on same disease state.
glioma_gift_orthogonal_vs_inverted_ccl_0.card_consequence: When a disease has both cell-fraction prior in literature AND Stage 1 A-score reading in framework, do NOT predict A-score direction from cell-fraction direction.
